info.name: Gymora API
info.description:
# Gymora API Postman Collection

## Overview

Complete Postman collection for the Gymora ASP.NET Core 9.0 REST API.

## Architecture

- **Authentication:** JWT Bearer Token with Refresh Tokens
- **Identity:** ASP.NET Core Identity with `ApplicationUser` (int PK)
- **Roles:** `SuperAdmin`, `User`
- **Rate Limiting:** IP-based fixed window policies
- **Global Exception Handling:** Custom middleware returning `Result<T>` envelope
- **ORM:** Entity Framework Core with SQL Server
- **Background Jobs:** Hangfire + MassTransit InMemory + EF Outbox
- **File Storage:** Bunny.net (Stream + Storage)
- **Payment:** Paymob integration
- **Validation:** DataAnnotations

## Authentication Flow

1. `POST /api/Auth/register` — Creates account + sends confirmation OTP
2. `POST /api/Auth/confirm-email` — Confirms with OTP (or use GET variant)
3. `POST /api/Auth/login` — Returns JWT + Refresh Token
4. All protected requests automatically use `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}`
5. `POST /api/Auth/refresh-token` — When access token expires
6. `POST /api/Auth/logout` — Revokes refresh token

## Standard Response Envelope

### Success
```json
{
  "isSuccess": true,
  "data": { ... }
}
```

### Error
```json
{
  "isSuccess": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "ERROR_CODE",
    "message": "Description"
  }
}
```

## Token Variables

| Variable | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| `accessToken` / `refreshToken` | Default tokens (set by Login) |
| `superAdminAccessToken` / `superAdminRefreshToken` | SuperAdmin role tokens |
| `userAccessToken` / `userRefreshToken` | User 1 role tokens |
| `user2AccessToken` / `user2RefreshToken` | User 2 role tokens |

> **Note:** Test endpoints are all `[AllowAnonymous]` and return plain `200 OK` (no response body envelope).

item.name: 07 Test & Utilities
item.description: Diagnostic and utility endpoints for testing email, push notifications, and subscription creation workflows. All endpoints are publicly accessible (`AllowAnonymous`).

request.description:
Send a test email to a predefined address.

Triggers `IEmailService.SendEmailAsync` with hardcoded recipient, subject, and body.

### Requires Authentication: No (AllowAnonymous)

Send a test push notification to the admin topic.

Triggers `INotificationService.SendToTopicAsync` with a hardcoded notification payload.

### Requires Authentication: No (AllowAnonymous)

Send a test notification via MassTransit outbox event.

Publishes a `TestNotificationEvent` through `IPublishEndpoint` which triggers the MassTransit consumer pipeline.

### Requires Authentication: No (AllowAnonymous)

Manually trigger owner subscription creation from an approved payment request.

Calls `IOwnerSubscriptionService.CreateFromApprovedPaymentAsync(paymentRequestId)`.

## Route Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Description |
|-----------|------|-------------|
| `paymentRequestId` | int | Approved payment request ID |

### Requires Authentication: No (AllowAnonymous)
